code='''def transform(grid):
    # Fill enclosed zero regions; assign colors in scan order.
    from collections import deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=set(); regions=[]
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
        if out[i][j]!=0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
        q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]; edge=False
        while q:
          x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y)); edge |= x==0 or y==0 or x==h-1 or y==w-1
          for a,b in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and out[a][b]==0 and (a,b) not in seen: seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
        if not edge: regions.append(cells)
    for k,cells in enumerate(regions):
      for x,y in cells: out[x][y]=7 if k==0 else 8
    return out
